acceptanceCases.given: Task T has attempts a and b in generation 0; child C declares parents P1 and P2.
acceptanceCases.then: a wins generation 0; after the loss the stale b is rejected and c wins generation 1; C becomes ready only when both declared parents hold receipts, and again after P1 is redelivered.
acceptanceCases.when: Select a, then b; lose T's artifact and finish the stale b and a recomputed c; deliver P1 twice, an undeclared PX, then P2; revoke and redeliver P1.

acceptanceCases.then: Reject the cycle and keep the incomplete child blocked.

evidence.testName: L045 partitioned owner epoch fences arbitration and failover recomputes lost artifacts

acceptanceCases.given: Shard epoch 1 owns tasks T1 and T2, both feeding child C on another shard; T1's completion was delivered and T2's is still in the outbox.
acceptanceCases.then: Epoch 0 is fenced; failover moves to epoch 2, resends T2's event under its original ID, revokes T1's generation-0 completion and reschedules T1 in generation 1 while T2 is untouched; C counts each event once and is ready only after T1's generation-1 completion.
acceptanceCases.when: Arbitrate from epoch 0, fail over with T1's artifact lost, deliver events twice, then select a recomputed T1 attempt.

acceptanceCases.given: Task partitioning receives a cycle or an unknown parent ID.
acceptanceCases.then: Reject the graph without partially releasing a ready frontier.

acceptanceCases.given: Two attempts and duplicate completion events reach different shards.
acceptanceCases.then: One immutable receipt wins; each child deduplicates predecessor ID independently.
acceptanceCases.when: Choose a winner under task-owner epoch and apply child inbox transitions.

acceptanceCases.then: Resume stable event identities, fence stale owners and recompute only absent artifact lineage.
acceptanceCases.when: Advance epoch and replay pending events.
